messages:
Elliot Chan: hey team, hi! starting as Product Designer today. quick list: Figma access, roadmap Notion, and where research notes live. also whos my onboarding buddy?

Samir Patel: welcome Elliot!! :tada: I handle Figma invites for design. drop your work email here or DM and Ill add you to the "Product Design" team and enable the "Redwood UI" library.

Elliot Chan: thanks Samir 60a DM sent (elliot@redwood.com). curious about two things: 1) do we restrict library updates? 2) where are component guidelines?

Samir Patel: library updates are gated. designers create a branch in the team library and then we ship via the weekly UI releases doc. component guidelines: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Redwood-UI-Guidelines (read-only until you're added).

Nora (PM): hi Elliot, roadmap lives in Notion: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap. Product PMs have edit access; others get commenter/viewer. If you want to contribute to a specific initiative, tag me and well add you to that page.

Elliot Chan: perfect. who grants Notion access?

Samir Patel: design-ops handles Notion groups. ping @design-ops or run the self-serve form: https://notion.redwood.com/access-requests and pick "product" + "design". devex-bot can also open a ticket.

devex-bot: Tip: run `/request-access notion product` to open a ticket with design-ops.

Jon (UX Research): welcome! research artifacts: recordings in Research Drive, synopses + binary transcripts in Notion under Research > Artifacts. If you want a quick reading pack, tell me which area (signup funnel, billing, infra) and Ill bundle 3 synths.

Elliot Chan: reading pack would be great. signup funnel + onboarding flows. also, is there a preferred way to annotate research in Figma?

Jon (UX Research): sent a reading pack link in DM and added you to the research-notes page. For Figma annotations we use comments + a short sticky in the file with "Research note:" prefix. If youre adding findings, drop them in the file comments and tag @jon-research.

Samir Patel: small FYI: enable the team libraries after youre in Figma: open file > Assets panel > Team Libraries > toggle "Redwood UI". If youre missing icons, run `Plugins > Redwood Tokens` to sync.

Elliot Chan: got the invites for Figma and Notion, thanks Samir & Jon. one more: who should I ping about setup of local dev preview (to test design + frontend)?

Nora (PM): frontend eng owners: @eng-frontend in #eng. I can put you in touch with the frontend buddy for your squad. We usually run a quick 30m pairing to get you a local preview.

Elliot Chan: appreciate it. can someone add me to the weekly design crits calendar?

Samir Patel: added you to calendar invite (Design Crits, Fridays 11am PT). If you want to present during your first week, shout and Ill slot you.

Elliot Chan: thanks everyone 60a super smooth onboarding so far. Ill ping if anything blocks me.
